stimulus.body: In einer Grammatikübung wird die Form verlangt, die der Regel der Stunde entspricht.

questions.stem: In a technical note, a registrar compares the evidence: Welche Antwort entspricht der Regel der Stunde?

options.text: Der Bildschirm is the monitor displaying text.
Die Tastatur is the keyboard used for typing.
Die Maus is the pointing device for the cursor.
Der Drucker is the device producing paper copies.

questions.explanation: Die Tastatur is the keyboard. The key is B, "Die Tastatur is the keyboard used for typing". Option A ("Der Bildschirm is the monitor displaying text") is wrong: confuses keyboard with monitor. Option C ("Die Maus is the pointing device for the cursor") is wrong: confuses keyboard with mouse. Option D ("Der Drucker is the device producing paper copies") is wrong: confuses keyboard with printer.

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.learningObjective: Recognize that 'sensibel' means sensitive

stimulus.body: In einer Grammatikübung wird die Form verlangt, die der Regel der Stunde entspricht.

questions.stem: During a seminar, a registrar compares the evidence: Welche Antwort entspricht der Regel der Stunde?

options.text: The prototype is heavy and sturdy.
The prototype is reasonable and practical.
options.misconception: reads the English sensible into sensibel

options.text: The prototype is sensitive to small input changes.
The prototype is cheap and disposable.

questions.explanation: Sensibel means sensitive, so the prototype reacts strongly to small inputs. The key is C, "The prototype is sensitive to small input changes". Option A ("The prototype is heavy and sturdy") is wrong: confuses sensitive with robust. Option B ("The prototype is reasonable and practical") is wrong: reads the English sensible into sensibel. Option D ("The prototype is cheap and disposable") is wrong: confuses sensitive with cheap.
